messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Nolan <chris.nolan@olivetech.com>, Sarah Park <sarah@talentbridge.co>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent approval: Cross-region offer exception for Senior SRE (Elena Morales)

Team,

Quick ask — Olive Tech is finalizing an offer for Elena Morales (Senior SRE). She's currently based in Barcelona and has a competing offer that includes a sign-on of $40k and an equity refresh expectation that puts total OTE at ~30% above our bands for EMEA. Hiring team requests an exception to the standard comp band and a one-time sign-on to close.

Key ask:
- Base/OTE: Requesting base $190,000 (USD converted comp) with $40k one-time sign-on. This is roughly 20% above our published band for level IC4 in EMEA/remote.
- Equity: one-time refresh grant of 0.04% (market-competitive) outside the current cycle.
- Timing: candidate needs final by EOD Friday (8/20) due to competing offer deadline.

Attached is an initial comp calc and candidate resume.

Why exception: Elena is a high-impact site reliability engineer with documented multi-region incidents and infra portability experience. Olive Tech has committed to a major production migration that this hire would lead. Losing her creates a >3 month delay risk.

Please advise next steps and whether finance/people can approve an out-of-band sign-on + equity refresh.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: offer_calc_olivetech_v2.xlsx; elena_morales_resume.pdf

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary. A couple of quick questions before we escalate to Comp Committee / CFO:
1) Can you confirm the candidate's current counteroffer details (base, sign-on timing, vesting expectations)?
2) Is this hire being onboarded fully remote (EU employment) or onboarded via a US contractor arrangement? Payroll/employment model affects tax and equity mechanics.
3) Please attach the candidate's most recent comp comp table plus the proposed grant doc text for the 0.04% refresh (how it vests, cliff).

Given the timeline, if finance pre-approves a one-time sign-on and we handle equity as an exceptional grant with a 3-year vest, we can move quickly. Mark will need projected FY26 budget delta impact for headcount and comp. Marissa — if you can confirm the earliest we can get DocuSign executed, that helps.

-Laura

Laura — thanks. Answers below and updated attachments included.

1) Counter details: Elena's other offer is USD-equivalent base $185k + $40k sign-on (paid 50% at start / 50% after 6 months); equity ~0.03% + annual refresh target that historically brought comp +20–30% in three years.
2) Employment model: Fully remote EU employee (Spanish payroll). We cannot switch to US contractor for this role due to local employment expectations.
3) Attachments: updated offer_calc_olivetech_v2.xlsx (breakdown of total comp deltas), proposed grant text in offer_summary_redwood.docx (3-yr vesting, 1-yr cliff with 24-month pro-rata acceleration on change of control).

Mitigations: We propose a staggered sign-on (25% at start, 25% at 3 months, 50% at 12 months) and an equity refresh that vests over 3 years with a lower initial refresh but stronger IRR for retention (0.04% one-time). That reduces near-term cash outflow.

Candidate note: Elena is willing to accept a firm answer by Friday if we meet base+sign-on+equity material terms; she prefers Redwood but wants compensation parity.

Jordan

Attachments: offer_calc_olivetech_v2.xlsx; offer_summary_redwood.docx

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent approval: Cross-region offer exception for Senior SRE (Elena Morales)

Jordan/Laura —

Finance perspective: we ran the numbers and the requested package (base $190k + $40k sign-on + 0.04% one-time grant) increases FY26 OPEX for EMEA headcount by ~$92k (cash flow) and impacts long-term equity pool by ~0.04%. Given the strategic risk described, finance is willing to provisionally approve the one-time sign-on with the proposed staggered payment schedule and to approve an exceptional equity refresh capped at 0.04% subject to the following conditions:

- Condition A: Marissa confirms total headcount for FY26 will not exceed the approved EMEA headcount plan by more than 1 FTE once this hire completes.
- Condition B: Offer must include robust retention milestones (6-12 month milestones tied to sign-on tranche).
- Condition C: Legal confirms local payroll/equity compliance for Spain (tax and withholding).

If Conditions A–C can be satisfied, I can批准 (approve) the exception to the comp band. We should get final sign-off from CFO but this is the green light subject to legal/people checks.

-Markus
CFO (interim)
Markus Klein

- Retention milestones: we will include the staggered sign-on tranches and a 12-month milestone that releases the final tranche.
- Legal: I’ve looped in Legal (ticket #LEGAL-2026-142) to confirm payroll and equity mechanics for Spain; expect response by EOD Thursday.
